Title: First, Give our team a Name
Detail_lesson: Lets come up with a really good name for our team
CustomInstruction: Think creatively but also functionally about naming.

Title: Second, Lets identify our customer
Detail_lesson: Who is our customer. Describe them
CustomInstruction: What innovative approach would you implement in your current project?

Title: Third, What is their pain point
CustomInstruction: Think about our direct or indirect customer. Who are we helping?

Title: Forth, How can we help
Detail_lesson: Think about what we can do for this customer to address the decided challenge
CustomInstruction: How can we help in meaningful ways?think and discuss specifics.
